en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic river rapid or waterfall rushing between rocky cliffs, with mist rising from the water. Two metal truss bridges span the gorge in the background, and small buildings or structures cling to the rocky shoreline on the left. The image is framed with a printed border, and a caption in the lower left corner reads "TROLLHÄTTAN. TOPPÖFALLET".
